resources.string: Live view from the rear camera
The camera lets us see the terminal screen and help you find the button you need. After you continue, Android will ask you to allow camera access.
Without the camera, KioskVision cannot see the terminal screen. Select Try again, and in the Android window choose to allow camera access.
Android will no longer ask for camera access. Select Open settings, open Permissions, then Camera, and allow access. Then return to KioskVision.
No rear camera was found on this device.
The camera is being used by another app. KioskVision will try again automatically.
The camera is disabled on this device by a setting or device policy.
The camera could not be started.
At the button. You press it yourself.
Keep the kiosk screen in view, facing it straight on.
Text recognition could not start on this device.
Hand tracking could not start on this device.
No Georgian voice is installed, so spoken guidance is in English. To hear Georgian, install a text-to-speech app with a Georgian voice, for example RHVoice, then restart KioskVision.
Spoken output is not available on this device. Messages are shown on screen.
Speech recognition is not available on this device.
This device’s speech recognition does not offer Georgian, so spoken commands may be misheard. Add Georgian to the speech recognition languages in the system settings.
KioskVision listens only after you press Voice command, to hear which button you want. The app does not save recordings. After you continue, Android will ask you to allow microphone access.
Without the microphone, voice commands cannot work. The camera keeps working. Select Try again, and in the Android window choose to allow microphone access.
Android will no longer ask for microphone access. Select Open settings, open Permissions, then Microphone, and allow access. Then return to KioskVision.
Stop, you are at the button. You can press it.
I can\'t see your hand. Move your whole hand into view, closer to the kiosk screen than to the phone.
Found %1$s. Bring your index finger to the screen.
Found %1$s. Before pressing, check the details: say, what is on the screen.
I couldn\'t find %1$s on the screen.
Some text could not be read reliably.
I can\'t see any text. Point the camera at the screen.
The screen is blurred. Change the camera angle slightly.
I cannot read the text. Move a little closer to the screen.
Cannot point to the button right now.
I have lost where the button is. Keep the kiosk screen in view.
Let me see the screen for a moment.
Speech recognition needs an internet connection.
Georgian speech recognition is not available on this device.
Speech recognition is not available on this device.
Microphone access is needed for voice commands.
